# Utilities whose corpus does not yet pass on Darwin.
#
# The macOS lane runs the WHOLE catalogue and compares the set of test
# functions that failed against this list. A name that fails and is not here
# fails the lane. The list is empty: every utility's corpus passes on Darwin,
# so any failure is a regression to fix, never a line to add. Cases where
# macOS's own GNU build reproduces a libc defect are marked as Darwin-oracle
# defects in the corpus, with the reason, rather than listed here (#9714).
#
# One test function per line.

# min-tests: 19000
#
# A run that executed fewer tests than this is not a measurement, and the
# gate refuses it rather than believing its narrower failure set: a runaway
# case can take the tail of a run down and still leave a DONE line behind.
